title: AI does not exist but it will ruin everything anyway
summary: Physicist and YouTuber Angela Collier argues in this hour-long video that AI as commonly described does not really exist. She covers the limits of the tools, biased datasets, and why they should not be used to make decisions.
why: HN people point to it as a clear, skeptical take on AI hype and the risks of unreliable AI classification, such as in mushroom foraging books.

quote.text: Angela Collier's excellent "AI does not exist but it will ruin everything anyway" video, which I recommend
